WITH atl_2020 AS (
  SELECT
    sid,
    name,
    iso_time,
    latitude,
    longitude,
    usa_wind,
    -- geography point for distance calc (lon, lat)
    ST_GEOGPOINT(longitude, latitude) AS pt
  FROM
    `bigquery-public-data.noaa_hurricanes.hurricanes`
  WHERE
    season = '2020'
    AND basin = 'NA'
    AND latitude IS NOT NULL
    AND longitude IS NOT NULL
),
-- order points per storm and compute incremental distances between consecutive points
per_storm_ordered AS (
  SELECT
    sid,
    name,
    iso_time,
    latitude,
    longitude,
    usa_wind,
    pt,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sid ORDER BY iso_time) AS rn
  FROM
    atl_2020
),
per_storm_pairs AS (
  SELECT
    cur.sid,
    cur.name,
    cur.iso_time,
    cur.latitude,
    cur.longitude,
    cur.usa_wind,
    cur.pt,
    cur.rn,
    prev.pt AS prev_pt
  FROM
    per_storm_ordered AS cur
  LEFT JOIN
    per_storm_ordered AS prev
  ON
    cur.sid = prev.sid
    AND cur.rn = prev.rn + 1
),
-- compute distance between consecutive points (meters), first point distance = 0
per_storm_dist AS (
  SELECT
    sid,
    name,
    iso_time,
    latitude,
    longitude,
    usa_wind,
    rn,
    IF(prev_pt IS NULL, 0.0, ST_DISTANCE(prev_pt, pt)) AS segment_meters
  FROM
    per_storm_pairs
),
-- cumulative distance per storm (meters) and convert to kilometers
per_storm_cumul AS (
  SELECT
    sid,
    name,
    iso_time,
    latitude,
    longitude,
    usa_wind,
    rn,
    segment_meters,
    SUM(segment_meters) OVER (PARTITION BY sid ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumul_meters
  FROM
    per_storm_dist
),
-- total travel distance per storm in kilometers
storm_totals AS (
  SELECT
    sid,
    name,
    MAX(cumul_meters) AS total_meters
  FROM
    per_storm_cumul
  GROUP BY
    sid, name
),
-- identify the third longest total travel distance storm (tie-breaker: sid)
third_longest AS (
  SELECT
    sid,
    name,
    total_meters
  FROM (
    SELECT
      sid,
      name,
      total_meters,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_meters DESC, sid) AS rn_overall
    FROM
      storm_totals
  )
  WHERE rn_overall = 3
)
-- final: for that storm, show ordered points with cumulative distance (km) and max sustained wind
SELECT
  p.sid,
  p.name,
  p.iso_time,
  p.latitude,
  p.longitude,
  p.usa_wind AS max_sustained_wind_kt,
  ROUND(p.cumul_meters / 1000, 3) AS cumul_distance_km
FROM
  per_storm_cumul p
JOIN
  third_longest t
ON
  p.sid = t.sid
ORDER BY
  p.iso_time

SELECT state_abbr, SUM(year_count) AS total_events
FROM (
  SELECT year, state AS state_abbr, COUNT(*) AS year_count
  FROM (
    SELECT state, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM event_begin_time) AS year
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_historic_severe_storms.storms_*`
    WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '1980' AND '1995'
      AND event_begin_time IS NOT NULL
      AND state IS NOT NULL
  )
  WHERE year BETWEEN 1980 AND 1995
  GROUP BY year, state
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) <= 1000
)
GROUP BY state_abbr
ORDER BY total_events DESC
LIMIT 5
